change_summary: Add NOT NULL column 'shipping_priority' to orders table with DEFAULT value to avoid locking on large table
service_context: order-service (Go), PostgreSQL 14.8, ~50k orders/day, peak traffic 2-4pm UTC. Table has 18M rows.
deployment_plan: Run migration during low-traffic window (3-5am UTC). Application code deployed after migration completes. Feature flag guards new column usage.
observability_evidence: pg_stat_activity monitored during migration. Slow-query dashboard: grafana.internal/d/pg-slow-queries
validation_evidence: Migration tested on staging (2M row copy of production). Completed in 4.2s with no lock contention.

seeded_gaps.description: No rollback plan specified for schema migration
No alerting configured for migration failure or query latency spike
SLO impact assessment is vague ('should be fine') with no quantitative analysis
